title: Change explanation schema
responsibility: Defines the scratch location, attempt outcomes and validated explanation of a particular unit change.

outputs.name: explanationsFile
outputs.description: The relative cache path used to stage reasons before a commit exists; it is .cache/harness/explanations.ndjson and is kept outside the source tree.

outputs.name: explanationOutcomes
outputs.description: The readonly tuple of outcome strings accepted by simplification and performance attempts; only improved, not-improved, and not-applicable are allowed.

outputs.name: explanationSchema
outputs.description: A strict Zod object schema for recording why one function or unit changed; its from and to content fingerprints bind the reason to that exact change, so it goes stale when the code changes again. It requires a unit matching unitIdPattern, nonempty trimmed symbol, behavior, attempt text, and recordedAt, an added/modified/removed change, nullable string fingerprints, and simplification/performance attempts with a declared outcome; file is optional and unknown keys are rejected.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: explanationSchema.parse throws a ZodError when a value fails the strict schema, including an invalid unit id or change/outcome, missing or invalid required fields, or unknown keys.
